title.zh: 公共任务经济：问题驱动的产业与人才转化，验证通过不等于采购或部署授权
title.en: Mission Economy: Problem-Led Industry and Talent Translation; Passing a Test Is Not a Procurement or Deployment Authorization

purpose: Organize the existing twin-track narrative, non-AI parity, failure governance and source rights into one readable mission-economy contract: industry and talent translation driven by real public problems, retestable tasks, professional services and exit mechanisms instead of invented enterprise lists, investment amounts or investment-attraction promises. Every task, entry/exit condition, procurement step, intellectual-property boundary and public-benefit return states its source type, version, permitted use, supported claim and what it cannot prove. No geometry, scene ID, project ID, maturity gate, rights status, approval, partner, procurement or operating claim is changed.

inheritance.frontend: Twin-track Jing-Zhang continuous civic track, intermittent proof track, failure siding, and civic timetable
backend: non-AI-first public rights and same-task dual paths
three-carrier failure writeback and active retirement
urban-metabolism whole-system accounting and exit destinations
century-time-museum verifiable and correctable cultural contract
not_rebuilt: scenario passport and public timetable brands
existing scene IDs and project IDs (frozen counts)

core_proposition.zh: 不以虚构企业名单、投资额或招商承诺证明产业价值；以真实公共问题、可复测任务、专业服务、独立复测和退出机制连接企业、高校、社区与城市部门。文件检查、技术测试、证据门、有限试用、采购与常态部署分别记录范围、责任、有效期和不可推出事项。
core_proposition.en: Industry value is not proven by invented enterprise lists, investment amounts or attraction promises; it is organized around real public problems, retestable tasks, professional services, independent retests and exit mechanisms linking enterprises, universities, communities and city departments. File checks, technical tests, evidence gates, limited trials, procurement and normal deployment each record their own scope, responsibility, validity period and what cannot be inferred.

four_axis_separation.runtime_state: ordinary | validation | failure | recovery; every public-facing action keeps an ordinary non-AI path and manual handover
four_axis_separation.maturity_gate: all actions remain G0_concept_only; no scene is upgraded by figures, machine PASS or PR merge
four_axis_separation.authorization_state: no authorization beyond concept documentation; procurement, limited trial and normal deployment each require separate written authorization with scope and expiry
four_axis_separation.service_state: no public service is claimed; external institutions remain suggested or pending-confirmation roles with 0 written confirmations

task_lifecycle.zh: 公共任务生命周期：问题发布 → 问题质量门 → 小团队公平准入 → 执行与离线原型 → 独立复测门 → 结果回流 → 退出或退役。任何一步失败均 fail-closed，恢复普通路径后才讨论修订；停止/退出不阻断普通公共路径与人工服务。
task_lifecycle.en: Public-task lifecycle: problem publication → problem-quality gate → fair small-team entry → execution and offline prototyping → independent-retest gate → results reflow → exit or retirement. Any step failing closes the action; ordinary paths and manual services continue; revision is discussed only after ordinary use is restored.

problem_quality_gate.zh: 任务进入前必须回答：真实公共问题是什么、受影响人群是谁、空间或运营触点在哪、可被反证的问题是什么、验证通过不授权什么。不满足问题质量门的任务不进入准入队列。
problem_quality_gate.en: Before entry, a task must answer: what real public problem, who is affected, which spatial or operational touchpoint, which falsifiable question, and what passing a test does not authorize. Tasks failing the problem-quality gate do not enter the entry queue.

small_team_fair_entry.zh: 准入不设账号门槛、不要求预付合规成本、同一任务存在人工或非 AI 路径；小团队可与大机构同池竞争，书面确认数按现实记录。
small_team_fair_entry.en: Entry has no account barrier, no upfront compliance cost, and a manual or non-AI path for the same task; small teams compete in the same pool as larger institutions, with written confirmations recorded only as they actually occur.

exit_and_retirement.zh: 退出条件：安全、隐私、无障碍、人工交接、普通使用或权利条件任一失败即退出；未解决根因前保持下架或主动退役。退出记录不进入招聘或人才排名。
exit_and_retirement.en: Exit triggers: any failure of safety, privacy, accessibility, manual handover, ordinary use or rights closes the task; the task stays down or is actively retired until root causes are resolved. Exit records are not used for hiring or talent ranking.

procurement_ip_boundary.zh: 原型采购不等于采购授权，更不等于部署授权。原型、有限试用、采购和常态部署分别需要独立的书面授权，各自注明范围、责任、有效期和不可推出事项。知识产权边界保持未解决（not_cleared），不把权利边界写成已解决。
procurement_ip_boundary.en: Prototype procurement is not a procurement authorization, let alone a deployment authorization. Prototype, limited trial, procurement and normal deployment each require separate written authorization with scope, responsibility, validity and non-inferable items. Intellectual-property boundaries remain unresolved (not_cleared); they are not written as resolved.

public_benefit_reflow.zh: 公共收益回流机制：任务结果、失败归档和独立复测结论以可理解形式回到沿线普通使用者；回流不依赖投资额或招商数据，反馈只作为下一轮问题输入，不自动代表满意、同意或合作承诺。
public_benefit_reflow.en: Public-benefit reflow: task results, failure archives and independent-retest conclusions return to ordinary corridor users in understandable form; reflow does not depend on investment amounts or attraction data, and feedback only feeds the next round of problem definition, never automatically representing satisfaction, consent or partnership.

decision_metrics.denominator: 进入准入队列的任务总数

risk_rehearsals.stop: fail-closed；活动热度和已投入成本不能覆盖停止条件
risk_rehearsals.recovery: 撤除临时设备，恢复普通路径与人工服务，通知受影响人群，最小化保存事件证据并发布可理解说明
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 根因修复、责任重新接受、版本更新、独立复测与公众影响复核完成后再讨论；否则主动退役

risk_rehearsals.risk: 公共问题沦为招商包装
risk_rehearsals.recovery: 恢复普通路径与人工服务，核对空间或服务损伤，记录责任角色类型与需外部确认的材料
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 问题质量门重新通过、独立复核完成后再讨论；否则保持下架

risk_rehearsals.recovery: 恢复普通路径，撤回未获书面确认的合作表述，记录真实参与状态
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 书面确认与真实课程参与证据齐备后再讨论；当前 0 个书面确认

risk_rehearsals.risk: 小团队承担不成比例合规成本
risk_rehearsals.stop: fail-closed；准入成本门槛即为失败信号
risk_rehearsals.recovery: 恢复人工与普通路径，移除不合比例的前置要求
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 准入规则修订并复核后再讨论

risk_rehearsals.stop: fail-closed；不把权利边界写成已解决
risk_rehearsals.recovery: 停止使用未清权资产，恢复普通路径，记录争议与待核验项
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 独立逐文件审计与权利清理完成后再讨论；当前审计为 0

risk_rehearsals.stop: fail-closed；退出记录不进入招聘或人才排名
risk_rehearsals.recovery: 恢复普通路径，隔离退出记录与人才评价，通知受影响人群
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 评价边界修订并独立复核后再讨论

risk_rehearsals.stop: fail-closed；不把字段覆盖率写成公共成效
risk_rehearsals.recovery: 恢复普通路径，核对收益回流主张的证据链
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 可验证分母与责任角色确认后再讨论

risk_rehearsals.risk: 外部机构被写成已承诺
risk_rehearsals.stop: fail-closed；未经书面确认不得写为合作方
risk_rehearsals.recovery: 撤回未确认表述，恢复普通路径
risk_rehearsals.reentry: 书面确认获得后再讨论；当前 0 个书面确认

screenless_journey.zh: 小微企业围绕公共任务发布厅的无屏旅程：非数字渠道获知开放条件与普通路径（无需注册账号）→ 默认进入普通公共状态，自愿且理解边界后才接触验证活动 → 同一任务存在人工或非 AI 方法，费用、权利、安全、无障碍、结果与完成时间可比较 → 异常时可停止、离开、申诉或要求人工接管，不承担系统失败成本 → 场地与服务恢复普通状态，个人敏感信息不进入公开档案 → 反馈仅作为下一轮问题输入。
screenless_journey.en: Screen-free journey of a small enterprise around the public-task hall: learns opening conditions and ordinary paths through non-digital channels without an account → enters the ordinary public state by default and only touches validation activities voluntarily with understood boundaries → the same task has a manual or non-AI method with comparable cost, rights, safety, accessibility, outcome and completion time → on anomaly the user can stop, leave, appeal or demand manual takeover without bearing system-failure cost → site and services recover to ordinary state and personal sensitive information stays out of public archives → feedback only feeds the next round of problem definition.

role_status.zh: 提出问题者、接受责任者、停止权人、恢复执行者、独立复核者均为角色待确认；外部机构、企业、高校和服务商均为建议角色或待确认角色，0 个书面确认。
role_status.en: Problem raiser, responsibility acceptor, stop authority, recovery executor and independent reviewer all remain roles-to-be-confirmed; external institutions, enterprises, universities and service providers remain suggested or pending-confirmation roles with 0 written confirmations.

field_unknowns: 责任主体：任务发布、准入审核、独立复测、停止与恢复执行均为角色待确认
外部机构书面确认：企业、高校、服务商 0 个书面确认
采购与知识产权边界：权利清理与独立逐文件审计均为 0
现实任务数量、参与小团队数量与退出事件
无屏与人工路径在真实场地中的连续性与使用测试数据
公共收益回流的可验证分母与责任记录方式
hard_no_go: 不得虚构企业名单、伙伴、采购、投资额或招商承诺
不得把任务发布写成政府采购，或把原型采购写成部署授权
不得把高校参与写成已经签约；书面确认数按现实记录
不得让大企业垄断入口，或让小团队承担不成比例合规成本
不得把失败记录用于招聘或人才排名
不得把知识产权边界写成已解决
不得用一个绿色状态同时表示测试、授权、采购和部署
不得把字段覆盖率、概念数量或机器 PASS 写成现实成效

authorization_boundary.maturity: all scenes and actions remain G0_concept_only
authorization_boundary.rights: not_fully_cleared; independent file-level clearance audits remain 0; public or professional reuse blocked_pending_terms_and_audit
authorization_boundary.approval: no approval, partner, funding, procurement, construction, operation or test result is claimed
authorization_boundary.pdf_note: All four A3/A0 publications are regenerated from the final bilingual Round 7–9 package and include this contract's figure; publication sync does not upgrade G0, temporary boundaries, rights status, or any real-world claim.
